title: Juicy Fluffy Dutch Lamb Stew
description: A traditional Dutch dish made with lamb, featuring a grassy and fluffy texture, perfect for festive occasions, using unwaxed lime for added flavor, and cooked to perfection in a kazan cauldron using a pressure cooker for a paleo friendly meal.
instructions: Heat the kazan cauldron over medium heat and add the lamb pieces to brown on all sides.
Add the chopped onion, carrots, and celery to the cauldron and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the minced garlic, dried thyme, salt, and black pepper to the cauldron and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb broth and unwaxed lime juice to the cauldron and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the cauldron, and simmer for 1.5 hours or use a pressure cooker to cook for 30 minutes.
Remove the cauldron from the heat and let it cool slightly before serving.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Refrigerate or freeze the stew for later use.
